Procedure: Threat actor operated FIFA-themed domains for phishing, malware delivery, and command-and-control, including aaworldcuptickets[.]com, fud2026[.]com, and multiple fake FIFA careers domains.
Victims were directed through QR-code and lure-based phishing workflows, including fake FIFA careers themes and a weaponized handbook PDF.
The campaign relied on victims opening a malicious PDF, installing the FIFA_WorldCup_Tickets.apk Android sample, or executing the WorldCup_Tickets_Viewer?gnp.exe payload.
The AiTM workflow captured credentials and secondary factors through backend endpoints such as /api/login, /api/twofa, /api/sms, and /api/email.
The Windows infostealer chain used an obfuscated batch script and a UPX-packed executable.
The Android crypto-miner used mining infrastructure over TCP port 9000, including pool[.]fud2026[.]com:9000 and pool-proxy[.]fud2026[.]com:9000.
The Android payload hijacked victim resources for cryptocurrency mining.
The Windows infostealer chain exfiltrated stolen victim data to Telegram and Discord.
